content.comment_body: Hello, A [product_name] [article_no] purchased in January 2023 is losing its date and time settings even after short power outages. Is there anything I should inspect or replace to prevent this problem? Battery or capacitor perhaps? Best regards, [user_name]

There have been multiple previous posts regarding this issue. The [product_name] does not use a battery but relies on a super capacitor. I have a [product_name] [version_no] from 2020 (FS [version_no]), and I haven't encountered this issue. It seems more common with newer [product_name] [version_no] units. If I were you, I would initiate a support request.
Hello, Consider performing a factory reset and reloading your program; this might resolve your issue. If it doesn't, you may need to replace the [product_name] base module.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that the [product_name] [article_no] frequently loses its date and time settings following any power interruption. The main concern is poor retention of configuration data when power is lost, probably because the device uses a super capacitor instead of a battery. Previous reports of this issue exist, and users suggest basic troubleshooting steps, but there are currently no clear or comprehensive solutions available for preventing time/date loss. This uncertainty compromises the reliability of the product, especially for applications requiring accurate timekeeping.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to consistently preserve date and time information during and after power failures, or to provide straightforward options (such as user-replaceable battery or capacitor) to maintain timekeeping continuity.
